name: 区立保育所に乳児等通園支援事業を追加
summary: 現在の条例では、区立保育所で行う事業に乳児等通園支援事業は含まれていません。この議案で事業を追加し、利用料は1時間300円を超えない範囲で規則に定めます。施行日は令和8年4月1日です。
changes: 区立保育所が行う事業に乳児等通園支援事業を加える
利用料を1時間当たり300円を超えない範囲で規則に定める
who: 乳児等通園支援事業の利用承認を受けた人
why: 区立保育所の事業に乳児等通園支援事業を加え、関連する規定を整えるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Adds infant and other child attendance support service to city-run childcare centers
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Katsushika City Ordinance on the Establishment, etc. of Childcare Centers
en.summary: Under the current ordinance, the infant and other child attendance support service is not included among the services provided at city-run childcare centers. This bill adds the service and sets the fee by rule at no more than ¥300 per hour. It takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Adds the infant and other child attendance support service to the services provided by city-run childcare centers
Sets the fee by rule at no more than ¥300 per hour
who: People approved to use the infant and other child attendance support service
en.why: The mayor says this is to add the infant and other child attendance support service to the services provided by city-run childcare centers and to update related provisions.
